initial.caption: Start with a = 2. A Value holds one number (data) and one gradient (grad), which is still zero.
initial.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 1 of 5 nodes visible; a=2

whilePlaying.caption: Start with a = 2. A Value holds one number (data) and one gradient (grad), which is still zero.
whilePlaying.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 1 of 5 nodes visible; a=2

afterPlay.caption: Add b = -3. Inputs are plain Values; no operation connects them yet.
afterPlay.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 2 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3

afterPause.caption: Add b = -3. Inputs are plain Values; no operation connects them yet.
afterPause.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 2 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3

mid.caption: Add the third input: c = 10.
mid.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 4 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3, mul=-6, c=10

final.caption: Backward pass: d.grad = 1. Then mul.grad = 1 and c.grad = 1; the chain rule gives a.grad = b = -3 and b.grad = a = 2.
final.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2 (grad -3), b=-3 (grad 2), mul=-6 (grad 1), c=10 (grad 1), add=4 (grad 1)

entry.caption: We already have d = a × b + c = 4. Backward starts at the output and walks the graph in reverse topological order, accumulating each node’s grad.
entry.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3, mul=-6, c=10, add=4

playing.caption: We already have d = a × b + c = 4. Backward starts at the output and walks the graph in reverse topological order, accumulating each node’s grad.
playing.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3, mul=-6, c=10, add=4

topo.caption: Only operations are numbered: ① + must run before ② ×. The × node’s gradient has to be complete before it can pass anything back to a and b — that is the reverse topological order.
topo.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3, mul=-6, c=10, add=4

seed.caption: Seed the output: d.grad = 1 (∂d/∂d). Every other grad is still zero.
seed.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3, mul=-6, c=10, add=4 (grad 1)

throughAdd.caption: Process ① +: d.grad = 1 flows back along both edges. The local derivatives are ∂d/∂mul = 1 and ∂d/∂c = 1, so mul.grad = 1 and c.grad = 1.
throughAdd.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2, b=-3, mul=-6 (grad 1), c=10 (grad 1), add=4 (grad 1)

throughMul.caption: Process ② ×: mul.grad = 1 flows to a and b. The local derivatives are ∂mul/∂a = b = -3 and ∂mul/∂b = a = 2, so a.grad = 1 × -3 = -3 and b.grad = 1 × 2 = 2.
throughMul.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2 (grad -3), b=-3 (grad 2), mul=-6 (grad 1), c=10 (grad 1), add=4 (grad 1)

final.caption: Done. Chain rule along a → mul → d: ∂d/∂a = ∂d/∂mul · ∂mul/∂a = 1 · b = -3. Reverse topological order made mul.grad complete before it was used.
final.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 5 of 5 nodes visible; a=2 (grad -3), b=-3 (grad 2), mul=-6 (grad 1), c=10 (grad 1), add=4 (grad 1)

inputs.caption: A neuron computes y = tanh(w · x + b) with three inputs. Start with the inputs x, the weights w, and the bias b — all plain Values.
inputs.sceneTitle: Scene 3 · One neuron: y = tanh(w · x + b)
inputs.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 7 of 14 nodes visible; w1=0.5, x1=1, w2=-1, x2=0.5, w3=2, x3=-1, b=2.5

playing.caption: A neuron computes y = tanh(w · x + b) with three inputs. Start with the inputs x, the weights w, and the bias b — all plain Values.
playing.sceneTitle: Scene 3 · One neuron: y = tanh(w · x + b)
playing.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 7 of 14 nodes visible; w1=0.5, x1=1, w2=-1, x2=0.5, w3=2, x3=-1, b=2.5

forward.caption: Squash with tanh: y = tanh(0.5) = 0.46. Forward pass done — now send the gradient back.
forward.sceneTitle: Scene 3 · One neuron: y = tanh(w · x + b)

seed.caption: Backward starts at the output: y.grad = 1 (∂y/∂y). Operations are numbered in reverse topological order; each one runs only after every node that consumes its result. The weight gradients are still zero.
seed.sceneTitle: Scene 3 · One neuron: y = tanh(w · x + b)

throughW1.caption: Process ×: p1.grad flows into w1 and x1. ∂p1/∂w1 = x1 = 1, so w1.grad = 1 × 0.79 = 0.79; ∂p1/∂x1 = w1 = 0.5, so x1.grad = 0.5 × 0.79 = 0.39.
throughW1.sceneTitle: Scene 3 · One neuron: y = tanh(w · x + b)

final.caption: All three weight gradients: w1 = 0.79, w2 = 0.39, w3 = -0.79. Gradient descent would subtract a small multiple of each (ticket 3); no training loop here.
final.sceneTitle: Scene 3 · One neuron: y = tanh(w · x + b)

inputs.caption: The same neuron as scene 3: y = tanh(w · x + b). This time we know the answer we want: a target t = 1. The parameters w and b are the Values that training will change.
inputs.sceneTitle: Scene 4 · One SGD step: follow the negative gradient
inputs.ariaLabel: Expression graph. 7 of 17 nodes visible; w1=0.58, x1=1, w2=-0.96, x2=0.5, w3=1.92, x3=-1, b=2.58

loss.caption: Measure the error: loss = (y − t)² = (0.46 − 1)² = 0.29. A bigger miss gives a bigger loss.
loss.sceneTitle: Scene 4 · One SGD step: follow the negative gradient

step.caption: Gradient descent takes one step along the negative gradient: p ← p − lr · g with lr = 0.1. Each parameter annotation shows −g and the new data; the table lists every weight before and after.
step.sceneTitle: Scene 4 · One SGD step: follow the negative gradient

after.caption: After one update the loss fell from 0.29 to 0.12. w₁ moved +0.08 because its gradient was -0.85. Gradients are cleared with zeroGrad() before the next forward pass. Scene 5 repeats this loop until the network learns.
after.sceneTitle: Scene 4 · One SGD step: follow the negative gradient

start.caption: Before training: the weights are random, so the loss is 1.32 and the dashed boundary misclassifies points. The loop will now run forward → loss → backward → step.
start.sceneTitle: Scene 5 · Loop until it learns: MLP + SGD

readout.title: Training loop · 3 hidden units · full-batch SGD · lr = 0.1

fastForward10.caption: Epoch 10: loss 0.62, 3 / 4 points correct. The boundary moves a little each round as the weights follow their negative gradients.
fastForward10.sceneTitle: Scene 5 · Loop until it learns: MLP + SGD

readout.title: Training loop · 3 hidden units · full-batch SGD · lr = 0.1

final.caption: Epoch 60: the loss fell from 1.32 to 0.3 and all four points are on the correct side of the boundary. The loop has learned the pattern: forward → loss → backward → step.
final.sceneTitle: Scene 5 · Loop until it learns: MLP + SGD

readout.title: Training loop · 3 hidden units · full-batch SGD · lr = 0.1
